blurb: Guests can enjoy 90-minute public and private cruises on a 40' pontoon with pedal stations and a motor, traversing Burlington waterfront and other points. Two-hour sailing cruises are available aboard traditional vessels with a licensed crew, including storytelling and photography. A 29-foot picnic cruiser is available for cozy social outings for up to six guests.
extraNote: BYOB and snacks allowed on pontoon and sailing cruises
